findings.title: ElastiCache replication group without auth token
findings.description: When transit encryption is enabled on an ElastiCache replication group, an auth token is required for Redis AUTH. Without one, any client that can reach the endpoint authenticates trivially.

evidence.expected: auth_token set when transit_encryption_enabled is true

findings.remediation: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.
